_reviewLabel: The ai-review reviewer is NOT yet wired for this repo. This stays TRUE anyway, deliberately: with no reviewer, pr:land does every step up to the merge and then exits 30 for a human, which is exactly today's behaviour plus the automation before it. Setting it false would auto-merge on CI alone — REMOVING review rather than replacing it. When the reviewer starts posting, this needs no change.
_reviewTimeoutMs: Short until a reviewer exists — no point idling 20 minutes for a review that cannot arrive.
_ciPaths: ci.yml has NO paths: filter — it runs on every push and PR to develop/beta/main. '**' says that directly; enumerating top-level directories would silently stop being true the moment one is added.
_sharedBlastRadius: A base move here forces a rebase even with no direct file overlap.
_hardStop: Never self-merges, however green. Mirrors the Autonomy contract section of AGENTS.md.
